subtitle: A daily report for each engine: what it did, what it cost and what came back.
sectionError: We couldn’t load this section. The rest of the report is not affected.
partialNote: Couldn’t load: {{sections}}. Parts that depend on them are marked below; the numbers elsewhere are not affected.
recentNote: Replies can arrive up to 72 hours after a message, so the last few days will keep changing.

generic.title: Couldn’t load the report
generic.text: Something went wrong while loading this report. Try again in a moment.

badDate.title: That date isn’t available
badDate.text: Pick a day from the last 90 days, up to today.

noEngine.title: That engine wasn’t found
noEngine.text: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another account. Pick another engine.

noAccess.title: You don’t have access to this report
noAccess.text: It covers everything the engines did, so it is limited to people who manage them.

emptyDay.title: No activity on this day
emptyDay.text: Nothing was added, sent, called or spent. Try another day, or check that the engine was active.

empty.calls: No calls were placed on this day
empty.email: No emails were sent on this day
empty.templates: No templates or subjects were sent on this day

table.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see all columns

filter.exportFailed: Couldn’t create the report file. Please try again.

did.title: What it did
did.subtitle: Who was added, what the engine decided and what went out.

back.title: What came back
back.subtitle: Replies, bookings and status changes, and which messages to rewrite.

cost.title: What it cost
cost.subtitle: Credits, WhatsApp charges and AI usage.

EMAIL_BOUNCE_HIGH.title: {{rate}} of emails bounced — clean the list before the next run
EMAIL_BOUNCE_HIGH.text: Invalid or unused addresses hurt your sender reputation. Remove them so later emails keep reaching inboxes.

critical.text: This is very high and can get your sending blocked. Remove invalid addresses before anything else goes out.

EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.title_one: 1 person marked an email as spam
EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.title_other: {{count}} people marked an email as spam
EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.text: Stop emailing them and review the wording and where the list came from. Complaints damage your sender reputation quickly.

WHATSAPP_FAILED_HIGH.title: {{rate}} of WhatsApp messages failed to deliver
WHATSAPP_FAILED_HIGH.text: Check that the phone numbers are valid and that the template is still approved.

OPT_OUTS.text: Look at the messages that triggered this. Several opt-outs in a day usually mean the wording or the timing needs a rethink.

CREDITS_LOW.title: Credits run out in {{runway}}
CREDITS_LOW.text: Based on your spend over the last 7 days. Top up soon to keep messages going out.

critical.text: Based on your spend over the last 7 days. Top up now to avoid interruptions.

email.title: Email opens and bounces aren’t tracked for your sender
email.text: Your emails go out through a sender that doesn’t report delivery events, so opens, bounces and complaints show as “Not tracked”.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp delivery isn’t tracked for your provider
whatsapp.text: Your WhatsApp provider doesn’t report delivery or read receipts, so those figures show as “Not tracked”.

generic.title: Some delivery details aren’t tracked
generic.text: Opens, bounces or read receipts aren’t reported for your current sender, so they show as “Not tracked”.

unknown.title: {{name}}
unknown.text: The report flagged this. Check the figures below.

peopleAdded.label: Leads added
peopleAdded.hint: Leads who joined the engine on this day. “New” means the lead was created that same day; the rest were already in your CRM.

messagesSent.label: Messages sent
messagesSent.none: Nothing was sent on this day
messagesSent.hint: Emails, WhatsApp and in-app messages sent on this day, both automatic ones and ones your team approved. Calls are counted separately.

replies.label: Replies
replies.emailNotTracked: Email replies aren’t tracked, so this counts WhatsApp replies only.
replies.hint: Replies received on this day. The reply columns in the tables below count replies to the messages sent on this day, so the two can differ.

callsConnected.label: Calls connected
callsConnected.hint: Calls that were picked up, as defined by your call settings.

demosBooked.label: Demos booked
demosBooked.hint: Demos booked on this day. Cancelled and rescheduled bookings are not counted.

conversions.label: Conversions
conversions.hint: People who moved to a converted status on this day.

creditsSpent.label: Credits spent
creditsSpent.hint: Credits used on AI-written messages, AI calls and the Lead Agent. WhatsApp charges are in a different currency, so they are shown beside it, not added in.

costPerDemo.label: Cost per demo
costPerDemo.noDemos: No demos booked, so no cost per demo
costPerDemo.hint: Credits spent divided by demos booked. Empty when no demo was booked.

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.subtitle: How many people made it through each step on this day.
funnel.note: Every step follows the messages sent on this day. Contacted includes calls placed; Replied counts replies to those messages, which can keep arriving for 72 hours.
funnel.partialTooltip: Only channels that report delivery are counted here, so this is a lower bound and is not compared with the steps around it.
funnel.deliveredNote: Delivery isn’t reported for every channel that was used, so Delivered is partial and no drop-off is shown for it.

trend.title: Last 7 days
trend.subtitle: Messages sent, replies and demos on the left axis; credits on the right.
trend.empty: Nothing sent in the last 7 days
trend.aria: Chart of the last seven days: messages sent, replies, demos booked and credits spent

channelsChart.title: Sent vs replied
channelsChart.subtitle: Per channel. Replied counts replies to the messages sent on this day.
channelsChart.aria: Bar chart comparing messages sent and replies for each channel
channelsChart.emailRepliesNote: Email replies aren’t tracked, so the email bar shows none.
channelsChart.inAppRepliesNote: Replies to in-app messages aren’t tracked, so no reply bar is shown for them.

costChart.title: Where the credits went
costChart.subtitle: Messages, calls and the Lead Agent.
costChart.empty: No credits or WhatsApp charges on this day
costChart.whatsapp: WhatsApp: {{amount}}{{estimated}}. Charged in a different currency, so it isn’t included in the credits above.

perEngine.title: How each engine did
perEngine.subtitle: Compare engines side by side for this day. Replies are those received on this day; reply rate is replies to the messages sent on this day.

lists.title: Leads added, by {{list}}
lists.subtitle: Who joined the engine on this day. Under each row, what the Lead Agent found for that {{list}}.

runs.title: Engine runs
runs.subtitle: What the engine decided on this day.
runs.decisionsHint: Each decision is one look at one person: send a message, create a task, wait or reply.
runs.expiredHint: Tasks nobody acted on before they ran out of time.

channels.title: By channel
channels.subtitle: Delivered, read and failed come from each channel’s own receipts. Replied and reply rate count replies to the messages sent on this day and keep growing for 72 hours, so they can differ from the Replies figure above.

calls.title: Calls
calls.subtitle: AI calls placed by the engine on this day.
calls.notDialledHint: Cancelled, expired or failed before the call was dialled.
calls.connectedHint: Calls that were picked up, as defined by your call settings.
calls.busyHint: The line was busy or the call was declined.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: Delivery and engagement for emails sent on this day. Figures are matched to emails by recipient and time, so they can be slightly off.
email.openedHint: Opens are counted when the email loads images, so the true number is usually higher.
email.bouncedHint: Addresses that couldn’t receive the email.
email.complainedHint: People who marked the email as spam.
email.bounceRateHint: Bounced divided by sent. Above 5% is worth cleaning up.
email.repliesNote: Email replies aren’t tracked yet, so reply figures cover WhatsApp only.
email.trackingOffNote: Your emails go out through a sender that doesn’t report delivery events, so only “Sent” is known.

templates.title: Which messages get replies
templates.subtitle: WhatsApp templates and email subjects, most sent first. Sort by reply rate to find the ones to rewrite. AI-written emails usually get a new subject each time, so they show one send each.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.subtitle: What the messages led to.
outcomes.demosBookedHint: Booked on this day. Cancelled and rescheduled bookings are not counted.
outcomes.demosScheduledHint: Demos taking place on this day, whenever they were booked.
outcomes.demosNotMarkedHint: Scheduled demos where nobody has recorded whether they happened.
outcomes.conversionsHint: People who moved to a converted status on this day.

statusChanges.title: Status changes
statusChanges.subtitle: Moves between pipeline stages on this day: by the engine, by your team, and by other automations such as AI calls and workflows.

costs.title: Costs
costs.subtitle: Everything the engine spent on this day.

credits.title: Credits
credits.subtitle: Spent on AI-written messages, AI calls and the Lead Agent.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp charges
whatsapp.subtitle: Billed by WhatsApp in a different currency, so kept apart from credits.
whatsapp.estimatedHint: Some prices weren’t reported by WhatsApp, so they are estimated from your rate card.
whatsapp.billableHint: Messages WhatsApp charges for. Replies inside the 24-hour service window are free.
whatsapp.missingRateHint: No rate is set for these messages, so they aren’t in the total or the table below.
whatsapp.partialHint: Some billable messages have no rate set, so this is a minimum and the real charge is higher.

ai.title: AI usage
ai.subtitle: Tokens used by the engine to write its decisions and replies.
ai.tokensInHint: Text sent to the AI model: the instructions and the person’s details.
ai.tokensOutHint: Text the AI model wrote back.
ai.trackedSince: Token counts are tracked from {{date}}. Earlier days show nothing.
ai.noUsage: No AI token usage recorded for this day.
ai.trackingStartedHint: Token tracking started with this release, so earlier days have no counts.

realCost.title: Real cost (USD)
realCost.subtitle: What the AI providers and the Lead Agent’s searches actually cost. Visible only to platform operators.
realCost.aiHint: What the AI models cost for this day’s decisions and replies.
realCost.leadAgentHint: Search and AI spend of the Lead Agent for this day.
